name: Chloe
source:
Chloe is the heroine of this game and is a zombie, the lowest species on the hierarchy. As she has been locked away from the outside world for her entire life, she’s very naive and knows little about the crucial hierarchy. She’s very curious and tries her best to learn about everything she can. She tends to have a positive outlook on life.

[From [url=https://zettairenai.wordpress.com/2018/02/23/ps-vita-ephemeral-fantasy-on-dark-review/]Zettai Renai[/url]]
